title: LUNA -> NI Kontrol Mk3
description: DAW-mode control surface for the Native Instruments Kontrol Mk3 keyboards — S49, S61 and S88.
The keyboard's screens show LUNA's mixer on the DAW button and the selected channel's
plugin chain on PLUG-IN, with NKS handover for Komplete Kontrol and Kontakt. Track
selection and record arm are shared with LUNA. Needs keyboard firmware 2.0 or later.
